source_reading.scope: Complete main demo: fragment extraction/expansion/query generation, IMDB interface/results, conclusion and references.

adjudication.basis: Von-QBE translates text/keyword requests into schema fragments and SPARQL, offers connected concept/property extensions, and executes against RDF or virtualized relational data. The schema guides a real data-query workflow; no measured user/scalability validation is reported in this demo.

codes.notes: The system accepts free text described as natural language, using similarity keyword matching. Named-entity parsing/resolution remains future work. Schema suggestions, expansion and data execution are demonstrated; no controlled-language grammar is established.
